property_summary: After any call to sendMoney, if the call to the target succeeds the contract's balance must decrease by the sent value; if the call fails the original contract reverts, so the balance stays unchanged. The mutant never reverts on call failure, so it can lose the sent Ether without actually transferring it, leaving the balance decreased by the sent value even when the target rejected the transfer.
change_summary: Delete the require revert on call failure so sendMoney does not revert on failed external call, changing the observable effect on caller.
